item.title: RFC 454545 – Human Em Dash Standard
item.description:
📝 U+10EAD HUMAN EM DASH Rendering engines MUST display the Human Em Dash identically to a standard em dash in order to preserve typographic compatibility. 2 Human Attestation Mark (HAM) To assert human authorship, implementations MUST precede the Human Em Dash with a Human Attestation Mark (HAM). Automated systems MUST NOT emit the Human Attestation Mark.
🔗 Read more: https://gist.github.com/bignimbus/a75cc9d703abf0b21a57c0d21a79e2be
